inverse_search.direction: Recover multiplication from its actual left division, not the forward recovery tracked by the uniform-term columns.
inverse_search.conclusion: No inverse expression whose two root subterms each have at most eight operations survives the saved models. In particular no inverse term of at most nine operations works uniformly for any of these four source laws. This is a checked Python enumeration, not a Lean proof.
